name: PS1-11afv field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the host galaxy of the superluminous supernova PS1-11afv, seen by Hubble.
label: ps111afv-hubble
story: A supernova far brighter than most once blazed here, in a home galaxy too faint to see from the ground. Hubble stared into the beast's lair to find that small galaxy.

claims.text: PS1-11afv is a Pan-STARRS ultra-luminous supernova whose host was targeted by Hubble
The targeted hosts are undetected from the ground
PS1-11afv is in the Pan-STARRS H-poor superluminous supernova sample
Hosts of these superluminous supernovae are compact dwarf galaxies
